title: Coherent tensor comparison by flat-term K-flat descent
statement: Let $(C,R)$ and $(C',R')$ be small ringed sites with independent universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Use module-sheaf categories and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $U$ be additive exact, preserving small coproducts. Give $U$ specified underived tensor and sheaf-Hom comparisons preserving units, associators, symmetry and evaluation, as in [def-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-transposition-data]. Fix on both derived categories the closed structures, tensor representative models and signed structural coherence of [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model, lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal]. Suppose termwise $U$ sends every flat-term K-flat complex to a flat-term K-flat complex. Then there is a tensor-only comparison: a natural total-complex isomorphism induced on each summand by the specified underived tensor comparison; a derived tensor isomorphism; its prescribed square on every flat-term K-flat representative; unit, associator and symmetry coherence; and the unit-normalization equation using the actual degree-zero single-complex factors. Every natural transformation with the same chain representative square equals this derived comparison. This theorem asserts no derived Hom comparison and no transposition or double-dual equation.

proof.text: Curry the specified underived tensor natural isomorphism and apply the proved source-library HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison construction. Preservation of coproducts makes every component invertible; its naturality theorem yields a natural chain isomorphism and map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX gives the prescribed summand formula.

proof.text: Every cochain complex has a quasi-isomorphism from a K-flat complex with flat terms by the existing independent-coefficient resolution theorem. Convert its ordinary tensor-right exactness to IsFlatOnSite using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply the proved derivedResolvingPairRestriction theorem: restriction to pairs of these representatives is fully faithful on derived bifunctors. This requires no functorial choice and no closure assumption on the resolving class.

proof.text: Apply the already proved generic tensorComparisonDescent theorem to the two cochain localization functors, termwise U, its exact derived functor and factor, the flat-term K-flat source category and the K-flat target category, and the given tensor models and chain comparison. Its fully faithful restriction hypothesis is the resolving-pair restriction constructed above; all exact-functor factors are isomorphisms. The theorem constructs the natural derived isomorphism and its representative square. Proof irrelevance identifies the supplied and produced K-flat witnesses.

source.place: Tag 0FPT (lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived), with Tags 06YS, 06YU and 0G7D; structural coherence step 4 of lem-sf-ringed-forget-tensor-descent.

proof.text: For two natural transformations with that representative square, precompose each component by the invertible image of the source tensor-model map and postcompose by the target tensor applied to the input factors. The representative equations make these composites equal. Cancellation gives equality on the resolving subcategory; faithful restriction gives equality everywhere, without assuming the natural transformations invertible.

proof.text: Apply the structural coherence theorem to the now-constructed chain and derived isomorphisms and their representative square. Its unit-normalization and four structural constraints, together with the separately proved uniqueness, give the required TensorComparison.

theorem ringed_forget_tensor_descent
    [∀ I : Type (max c v r), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) U]
    (_preserves_flat_models :
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (RingedTensorModules.{c, v, r} J R) ℤ,
        P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients →
        (∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{c, v, max c v r, max c v r} (R := R) (P.X p)) →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R')
        ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ∧
          ∀ p : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{d, vd, max d vd s, max d vd s}
            (R := R') (U.obj (P.X p))) :
    ∃ m : TensorComparison.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
        J R J' R' U u SB TB βB cB SA TA βA cA,
      ∀ μ' : SB.tensor ⋙ U.mapDerivedCategory ⟶
          (U.mapDerivedCategory.prod U.mapDerivedCategory) ⋙ SA.tensor,
        RepresentativeModel.{c, v, r, d, vd, s, wb, wa}
          J R J' R' U SB TB SA TA m.chain μ' → μ' = m.derived.hom
